SNAIL SWITCH - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-snailswitch.txt.

Race along a curving vine through a misty forest. Up goes to the upper side;
Down goes to the underside. Holding a direction keeps that side. A also toggles.
Avoid woody thorns, patrolling inchworm caterpillars and amber sticky sap drops;
collect every pink fruit. Missing one ends your run. Caterpillars extend and arch as they crawl.
The pace builds smoothly, with medals at 100, 250, 500 and 1000 points.

Run SnailSwitch.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad                   Keyboard
  upper / lower side      Up / Down                 Up / Down arrows
  toggle / start          A                         X
  start                   A, Up, Down or Start      X, arrows or Enter
  pause / resume          Select or Start           Backspace, Esc or Enter
  players 2-4 join         A on their pad, on title  P2: H (G leaves)
  P2 upper / lower                                  W / S
  P2 pause                                          R / T

Up to four full-size snails share the same vine, each with independent controls.
The title is the actual frozen start scene; starting retains the world and camera.
F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: SnailSwitch.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
Widescreen: the picture follows the shape of the window (drag its edges or go
fullscreen: a wider window shows more of the vine ahead). To fix it: --width 427
(16:9), --width 520 (phones), or --aspect 4:3 for the classic 320x240.
The best score is saved in snailswitch.srm next to the exe.
